thesis: The speakers argue that marketplace business models are highly attractive to investors due to their strong defensibility and inherent network effects, which make them harder to disrupt as they grow. The report evaluates these platforms primarily by Gross Merchandise Value (GMV), noting that while this metric indicates consumer spend, investors also consider growth in active supply and demand, conversion rates, and user retention.
